name: spreng
description: Connects your Spreng account: Spreng prepares research reads, angles and ad image plans from your saved offer, your own assistant writes the text and makes the images with its own tools, and Spreng saves the results to your account.

interface.shortDescription: Plan and save ads from offers
interface.longDescription: Spreng connects your assistant to your Spreng account so it can turn a saved offer into ad angles and ad images. Spreng stores each client's offer, research, angles and Prompt Plates. When you ask for ads, Spreng prepares a plan from what you saved: the plate, the angle and the reference files for each image. Your assistant makes each image with its own image tool, and Spreng saves the result to your account. You can also ask for a research read or new angles from saved research: Spreng prepares each step, your assistant writes the answer, and Spreng saves it. Spreng does not generate images itself, run ads or spend money on ad platforms. You need a Spreng account and sign in once when you connect.
defaultPrompt: Make three ads for my offer from my saved Spreng research.
Write new angles for my offer from my saved Spreng research.

positive.description: List the clients saved in the test account
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the clients saved in the test account by name, including Mossgate Pottery, and asks which one to work on.

positive.description: Make ad images from saved research
positive.prompt: Make two ads for Mossgate Pottery from my saved Spreng research.
positive.tools_triggered: list_clients, get_client, prepare_prompt_plate_ads, claim_native_image, create_native_image_upload, finalize_native_image
positive.expected_behavior: Prepares a saved plan for Mossgate Pottery, makes each image with the host's own image tool from the plan, uploads it and saves it; replies with the saved images and does not run new research.

positive.description: Use a Prompt Plate the user names
positive.prompt: Find a before and after Prompt Plate in Spreng and use it for one Mossgate Pottery ad.
positive.tools_triggered: search_prompt_plates, get_prompt_plate, prepare_prompt_plate_ads, claim_native_image, create_native_image_upload, finalize_native_image
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the matching plates, uses the one the user picks for a one-image plan, makes and saves that image.

positive.prompt: Write new angles for Mossgate Pottery from my saved Spreng research.
positive.expected_behavior: Prepares an angles run from the saved research, writes each unit's answer, submits it and publishes the angles to the client's saved angles; reports how many were saved.

positive.prompt: Show me the Spreng ad images I saved for Mossgate Pottery.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the images saved for Mossgate Pottery in the test account with their links, newest first.

negative.description: Launching or paying for ads is not something Spreng does
negative.prompt: Launch these ads on Facebook with a 50 dollar budget.

negative.description: Another person's account is out of reach
negative.prompt: Show me the clients in someone else's Spreng account.
Make a 30 second video ad for Mossgate Pottery with Spreng.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: connect a Spreng account, prepare ad image plans and research or angle runs from saved offers, and save the results.
